statement: Mixed stock damaged cartons or tangled hangers exceed approved grasp set
response: Reject to labeled human exception zone

statement: Employee or stock cart enters narrow shared aisle
response: Low-speed mode stop-distance tests and right-of-way rule

statement: Inventory interface sends wrong location or variant
response: Confirm SKU size color and scan at pick and handoff

statement: Stair or fire-door route is blocked or outside envelope
response: Route-health check alternate handoff and safe return
trigger: Route unavailable for more than 10 minutes

statement: Operational acceptance is mistaken for a scalable business case
response: Separate G5 operational and G6 financial gates

statement: Approved shoe boxes weigh 0.3 to 8 kilograms
response: Representative sample and scale log before FAT

statement: Returned associate time can be used for customer-facing work
response: Observe schedules and floor coverage; do not book cash savings automatically
trigger: No documented staffing or customer impact

statement: Annual gross value is below annual recurring cost
response: Hold chain rollout and seek quote-backed cost down or additional measured value

statement: Test inventory tenant identity and tablet are available by week 5
response: Weekly dependency review and test harness fallback
